questions.question: What was a polis in ancient Greece?
choices: A royal tomb
A trade currency
A city-state
A military ship

questions.question: Which city-state is especially associated with citizen democracy?
choices: Athens
Sparta
Corinth
Thebes

questions.question: Which city-state emphasized military training for male citizens?
choices: Athens
Sparta
Miletus
Ephesus

questions.question: What was the agora?
choices: A hereditary royal title
A naval weapon
An Olympic event
A public gathering and market area

questions.question: Which philosopher taught through questioning and discussion?
choices: Socrates
Homer
Pericles
Herodotus

questions.question: Who established a large empire that spread Greek culture eastward?
choices: Solon
Leonidas
Alexander the Great
Themistocles

questions.question: Which conflict was fought primarily between Athens and Sparta and their allies?
choices: Punic Wars
Peloponnesian War
Persian Civil War
Trojan War

questions.question: How did Greece's mountains influence political development?
choices: They made land communication easier everywhere
They created one continuous fertile river valley
They prevented all maritime trade
They helped communities develop as separate city-states

questions.question: Why was sea trade important to many Greek communities?
choices: It connected coastal settlements and supplied needed goods
It allowed every city to become completely self-sufficient
It eliminated the need for farming
It prevented cultural contact with other peoples

questions.question: What limited participation in Athenian democracy?
choices: Every adult resident voted in the assembly
Only hereditary kings could introduce laws
Women, enslaved people, and resident foreigners lacked citizen political rights
Citizen men were legally barred from public debate

questions.question: What distinguished Athenian direct democracy from representative democracy?
choices: Athenians never voted on public issues
Citizens voted on policy themselves rather than only through elected lawmakers
Athenian laws were written only by foreign officials
Representatives held permanent hereditary seats

questions.question: What did the Persian Wars encourage among some Greek city-states?
choices: Permanent political unification of all Greece
The immediate abolition of slavery
The surrender of all Greek fleets to Persia
Cooperation against a common outside power

questions.question: How did the Delian League contribute to tensions?
choices: Athenian dominance and tribute demands angered allies
Sparta used it to govern all of Persia
It prohibited Athens from maintaining a navy
It removed every dispute between city-states

questions.question: What does Hellenistic culture refer to?
choices: Greek culture before any city-states developed
A culture restricted entirely to Sparta
Greek culture interacting with other cultures after Alexander's conquests
Roman culture after the fall of the Western Empire

questions.question: Why are Greek philosophical traditions historically significant?
choices: They ended debate about the natural world permanently
They encouraged reasoned inquiry into knowledge, ethics, and government
They required every city to adopt the same religion
They replaced all written communication with oral legends

questions.question: A citizen votes directly on a proposed law in an assembly. Which system does this resemble?
choices: Spartan hereditary kingship
Persian imperial administration
Roman imperial succession
Athenian direct democracy

questions.question: Which sequence places these Ancient Greece events in chronological order?
choices: Persian Wars, Peloponnesian War, Alexander's conquests
Alexander's conquests, Persian Wars, Peloponnesian War
Peloponnesian War, Alexander's conquests, Persian Wars
Persian Wars, Alexander's conquests, Peloponnesian War

questions.question: Which comparison of Athens and Sparta is accurate?
choices: Both granted equal political rights to every resident
Both rejected slavery throughout their histories
They differed in political institutions and civic priorities
Both depended on the same form of citizen government

questions.question: Which evidence challenges the claim that ancient Greek democracy meant universal equality?
choices: Athens held public assemblies
Political rights were restricted to a minority of residents
Greek communities traded across the Mediterranean
Greek authors wrote plays

questions.question: A city in Alexander's former empire combines Greek architecture with local religious practices. What does this illustrate?
choices: Complete cultural isolation
The disappearance of all local traditions
The end of long-distance exchange
Cultural blending
